reasons.A: Modern, even-paced expository prose with a hedging first-person 'I do not think' and a balanced wrap-up; none of the passage's staccato declaratives, dashes, exclamations or archaic register.
reasons.B: Period diction and rhetorical questions fit, but long semicolon-laden periodic sentences dominate, with little of the passage's short-sentence punch, and the 'I think'/'I know not' asides confide more than the passage's impersonal assertion does.
reasons.C: Closest movement: long sentences broken by curt declaratives ('There is no other rod.'), the parallel 'It is not... It is...' run, rhetorical questions and dashes, the archaic 'befell', and a firm impersonal stance, all without overloading these habits.
